correctness.rationale: The proof reduces each time slice for a two-point signal to a two-term character equation. The character map has exactly \(d=\gcd(N,s)\) preimages per value. A finite family of explicit nonzero polynomial conditions guarantees that no coefficient ratio can cancel two different time slices; a distinct-prime window witnesses that the bad polynomials are proper. This yields exactly zero or \(d\) STFT zeros, and the ordinary Fourier calculation is the same one-slice root equation. The extremal formula follows from the largest proper divisor. The bundled exact replay checks the combinatorial and arithmetic skeleton through \(N=300\).

value.rationale: The result resolves the first nontrivial exact-support stratum of a published cyclic Fourier/STFT support-pair problem for every order \(N\), including composite orders where the reverse inclusion was explicitly left difficult. The closed formula \(\phi(\mathbb Z_N,2)=N^2-N/p\) turns earlier isolated numerical evidence into an all-order theorem and exposes the governing subgroup index through \(\gcd(N,s)\).
